answer: Audits are recorded in canyon, queued in grove, and prism publishes the wait time. A farm of 283 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 26 identities per epoch. A farm of 3208 identities would post 4044 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
